$comment: Hand-maintained. How each agent discovers these skills. 'verified' records what was tested on this machine and when; null means not tested.

claude-code.discovery: name and description of every skill in context each turn; SKILL.md loaded on use

verified.how: fresh claude -p session (haiku) in a scratch project whose .claude/skills held Windows junctions to skills/*; it quoted the linked descriptions verbatim
verified.scope: project-level .claude/skills; user-level ~/.claude/skills is the same loader

codex.discovery: name and description in context; follows symlinked skill folders
codex.optionalBlock: marked pointer block in $CODEX_HOME/AGENTS.md via --codex-block on

verified.how: fresh codex exec (read-only) in a scratch repo whose .agents/skills held junctions to understand-code and run-autonomous; it quoted both descriptions verbatim, and answered NONE when the junctions were absent
verified.scope: repo-level <repo>/.agents/skills; user-level ~/.agents/skills not exercised to avoid touching the real home

cursor.discovery: reads Agent Skills folders, including Claude's and Codex's

other.fallback: the repository's AGENTS.md points to ~/agent-skills/working-agreements/AGENTS.md; skills can be read as plain Markdown from ~/agent-skills/skills/<name>/SKILL.md
